author: MH2Oworth
body:
Hi! i love you're server but in march i got banned because someone thought i was hacking (Anti KB) :(. I thought it was a mistake but it didn't get resolved until today August 3 2016. I am asking you with the bottom of my heart to accept my appeal please i didn't do anything :( . But apart from that your server is really enjoyable I hope you read this and let me join your server again thanks for being a great server :)          I was banned by PieZ just so you know

-MH2Oworth

replies.author: Myworld6
replies.body:
Hello, MH2Oworth,

As the moderator who banned you is no longer a staff member, I will forward this appeal to the seniors. In the meantime, please be patient while they try to respond as quickly as possible.

Kind regards,
Myworld.

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Hello,

After reviewing your infractions, I've decided to deny your appeal. You have been caught ban evading, which is also illegal. As you've also broken another rule while banned, your appeal is denied. In case you have any further explanation, I'll keep this open.
